title: Compact exec snapshot playbook for roadmap triage and ask prioritization
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: produce a compact (15–20 slide) exec snapshot playbook that the product org can use to run fast roadmap triage sessions with execs and cross-functional partners. The playbook should standardize pre-reads, a 30-minute run cadence, a scorecard for asks (impact, effort, risk, runway), and a clear decision output (defer / commit / escalate). This ticket covers template creation, data pulls, stakeholder alignment, dry run, and handoff to EngOps for recurring scheduling.

Scope: create the artifacts and operationalize the lightweight process for monthly and quarterly readouts: pre-read packet, 30-min meeting agenda, slide templates, a one-click data snapshot query for runtime cost/latency/eval regressions, OKR delta table, risk register snapshot, and a short follow-up automation (notes -> Linear tickets with tags). Exclusions: not delivering the full QBR deck for exec board; this is the standardized kit used to surface signals and make prioritization asks.

Why now: increasing frequency of cross-team roadmap conflicts and more ad-hoc escalation asks. We need a reproducible, low-friction ritual that surfaces unit economics, customer signals, and technical risk so execs can make faster tradeoffs without large prep overhead.

Deliverables: template pack (Google Slides), Confluence runbook with step-by-step pre-read data pulls, query snippets for Console dashboards, a short training doc for PM/Eng leads, and a one-hour dry-run with senior execs.

Acceptance criteria and success metrics listed below.
acceptance_criteria: Slide template + example populated with last-month data uploaded to Drive (drive.redwood.ai/roadmap-playbooks/pm-250777)
Confluence runbook with checklist and required owner for each step (pre-read, data pulls, meeting owner, note taker)
Data snapshot queries (example SQL/Looker explores or console-dashboard links) committed to the playbook and validated by Observability team
Dry-run completed with at least 3 cross-functional leads and capturing feedback -> revisions tagged
Automation mapping from meeting notes to Linear tickets implemented (Zapier/GHA or Ops workflow) with sample mapping and 2 example tickets created from the dry-run
